scope: Main menu Credits entry: original MenuCredits world request, custom game type and the END/CREDITS roll flag; no renderer, font or text-overlay code imported

references.purpose: MenuCredits: outside a world StartNewGame("Credits", STARTGAME_NORMAL, GAMETYPE_CUSTOM, LOADTYPE_NEW_GAME, DIFFICULTY_MEDIUM) without SetCharacterInfo; inside a world the text-only GS_CREDITS screen. PreLoadWorld sets m_bRollCredits for END/CREDITS (with or without the Worlds prefix); OnExitWorld clears it; GS_PLAYING Esc opens the in-world menu.
CCredits/CCredit roll: TEXT resource parsing (## separators, >TIME:, >END), fade/hold timers, speed keys and endless wrap in CM_CREDITS mode. Not ported; recorded as the remaining overlay.
Credits text comes from a cres.dll resource of type TEXT named CREDITS (CREDITS_AO for the add-on). Not read yet.
TypeCustom/OPT_FLAG_CUSTOM filtering applies to GAMETYPE_CUSTOM worlds; the existing port is unchanged.

adaptations: The world name test runs at player entry on the normalized world path instead of in PreLoadWorld; it has no consumer other than diagnostics yet.
GAMETYPE_CUSTOM is accepted only for fresh NEW_GAME requests; NEW_LEVEL, saves and multiplayer types still refuse explicitly.
The in-world Credits row stays disabled because the text-only GS_CREDITS screen is not ported.
